rocketmq_ui_page_placeholder: Select a connection from the sidebar
rocketmq_ui_hint_namesrv: Separate multiple addresses with semicolons; the client failovers automatically
rocketmq_ui_field_secret_placeholder: Stored encrypted; leave empty to keep the current value
rocketmq_ui_field_access_key_placeholder: AccessKey (leave empty if ACL is disabled)
rocketmq_ui_field_secret_key_placeholder: SecretKey (leave empty if ACL is disabled)
rocketmq_ui_hint_acl: Leave both empty if the cluster has no ACL enabled
rocketmq_ui_tls_verify_server: Verify server certificate (a truststore is required for self-signed CAs)
rocketmq_ui_tls_verify_warning: Server certificate verification is off: the peer's identity will not be validated. Recommended for testing environments only
rocketmq_ui_tls_hint_truststore: PEM CA certificates (.pem/.crt/.cer) are used as-is; .p12/.pfx are parsed as PKCS12 and .jks as JKS, then converted automatically
rocketmq_ui_tls_hint_keystore: For one-way TLS (server verification only), leave both the Keystore file and password empty; for mutual TLS, pick a keystore containing the private key and enter its password
rocketmq_ui_error_tls_truststore_require: A truststore file is required when server certificate verification is enabled
rocketmq_ui_error_tls_truststore_passwor: A truststore password is required when server certificate verification is enabled
rocketmq_ui_error_tls_keystore_pair: A Keystore file is selected: enter its password, or click Clear to leave everything empty if you don't need mutual TLS
rocketmq_ui_error_tls_keystore_pem: The keystore only accepts JKS/P12 stores containing a private key; use PEM certificates directly as the truststore instead
rocketmq_ui_error_object_scan_range: Object scan interval must be 1 - 1440 minutes
rocketmq_ui_error_status_scan_range: Status scan interval must be 5 - 3600 seconds
rocketmq_ui_group_empty: No consumer groups in this cluster
rocketmq_ui_topology_empty: No displayable objects in this cluster
rocketmq_ui_topic_props_no_routes: No route info; the topic may not be registered on any broker yet
rocketmq_ui_partial_scan_banner: Some data was not refreshed: %1$s unavailable
rocketmq_ui_partial_scan_hint: Usually an ACL restriction or a timeout; the rest was refreshed
rocketmq_ui_topic_delete_confirm_text: Delete topic %1$s? This cannot be undone and removes all metadata from the brokers and the NameServer.
rocketmq_ui_group_props_no_rows: No offset data for this group (may never have consumed)
rocketmq_ui_group_create_name_hint: Letters, digits, dash, underscore and % only; immutable after creation
rocketmq_ui_group_create_name_invalid: Name allows letters, digits, dash, underscore and % only; no spaces or non-ASCII
rocketmq_ui_group_props_progress_unavail: Unable to fetch detailed offset info for this group.
rocketmq_ui_group_props_no_route_sub: The retry topic of this group has no route in the NameServer — usually because the group has never consumed (the broker has not reported it yet), automatic topic creation is disabled on the server, or POP consumption is used.
rocketmq_ui_group_props_failed_sub: Consumer progress query failed; click retry, or check the server connection and permissions.
rocketmq_ui_group_props_no_stats_sub: This group has no consumer progress yet — the broker returned an empty offset table, which usually means no consumer has ever been online for it.
rocketmq_ui_group_props_progress_group_m: This consumer group does not exist.
rocketmq_ui_group_props_progress_denied: No permission to access this consumer group.
rocketmq_ui_group_props_group_missing_su: No subscription config for this group exists on the brokers — the name may be misspelled, or the group has been deleted. That is also why there are no offsets to show.
rocketmq_ui_group_props_progress_no_memb: This consumer group has no progress yet.
rocketmq_ui_group_props_no_members_sub: The group exists but has no online consumers and has never committed an offset — data appears once a consumer starts and completes a fetch.
rocketmq_ui_group_props_broker_fallback_: Offsets were read directly from the brokers — this group's retry topic has no route in the NameServer, so the group-level query is unavailable.
rocketmq_ui_group_props_permission_sub: The current account may not have permission for this consumer group — check the ACL configuration.
rocketmq_ui_group_props_metrics_unavaila: Progress data unavailable (retry topic has no route, or the query failed)
rocketmq_ui_group_delete_confirm_text: Delete consumer group %1$s? This removes the subscription group config from all brokers and cannot be undone.
rocketmq_ui_topic_create_name_hint: Letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore and % only; immutable after creation
rocketmq_ui_topic_create_name_invalid: Name allows letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore and % only; no spaces or non-ASCII
rocketmq_ui_topic_create_queues_invalid: Queue count must be an integer greater than 0
rocketmq_ui_msg_browse_no_commit_hint: This browse only pulls messages without committing offsets; consumer progress is not affected
rocketmq_ui_msg_detail_props_empty: No user properties on this message
rocketmq_ui_send_empty_body: Message body is empty; send anyway?
rocketmq_ui_send_preview_truncated: Content too large; only the first 10000 characters are previewed. The full content is sent unless edited
rocketmq_ui_send_close_confirm_text: Messages are still being sent; closing will abort the remaining tasks. Close anyway?
rocketmq_ui_broker_props_no_data: No cached details for this broker. Rescan to refresh.
rocketmq_err_refusal_failed: Not connected: the last request failed (%1$s)
rocketmq_err_refusal_disconnected: Not connected: connect this RocketMQ from the sidebar first
rocketmq_err_refusal_released: Not connected: the admin client was released — reconnect first
rocketmq_err_no_broker_topic_config: No available broker in the cluster to query the topic config
rocketmq_err_no_broker_group_config: No available broker in the cluster to query the subscription group config
rocketmq_err_nameserver_connect: Cannot connect to NameServer %1$s: check the address and port (default 9876)
rocketmq_err_acl_failed: ACL authentication failed: check the AccessKey / SecretKey
rocketmq_err_tls_handshake: TLS/SSL handshake failed: check the certificate files, Truststore config and cluster TLS mode (the broker needs tls.enable)
rocketmq_err_not_connected_messages: Connection not established or already lost; cannot read or send messages
rocketmq_err_queue_not_found: Queue %1$d not found (topic routing may have changed — click Read to refresh)
rocketmq_err_not_registered: Connection not registered: it was deleted or the module is not initialized
rocketmq_err_module_not_initialized: RocketMQ module not initialized; cannot test the connection
rocketmq_err_system_topic_delete: Built-in system topic cannot be deleted: %1$s
rocketmq_err_send_client_error: Send failed: %1$s (if the route is missing, check that the topic exists and the NameServer is reachable)
rocketmq_err_send_timeout: Send timed out (%1$ss): the broker did not acknowledge in time
rocketmq_err_progress_timeout: Query timed out (no response from the broker within %1$ss)
rocketmq_err_keystore_pem_unsupported: The keystore supports JKS/P12 only (must contain a private key); use the PEM certificate directly as the Truststore: %1$s
rocketmq_err_keystore_no_private_key: No private key entry in the keystore (mutual TLS requires a keystore with a private key): %1$s
rocketmq_err_keystore_no_cert_chain: The private key entry has no certificate chain: %1$s
rocketmq_err_cert_load_failed: Failed to load the certificate file (check format and password): %1$s (%2$s)
rocketmq_err_pem_no_certificate: No certificate in the PEM file (private key only?); the Truststore needs a certificate file: %1$s
